summary: Three bounded source-specific proposals were added after route-check, duplicate screening, and exact checks of the exposed f77r/f80v/f85r1 arrays. They remain unreviewed hypotheses: no meaning, reader agreement, or recurrence is treated as confirmation.

items.shared_mechanism: A retained kain head combines with separable q-presence and ol split/fused boundary effects.
items.close_rival: Unrelated whole words or a line-specific spacing/template grammar.
items.distinguishing_consequence: The literal q-present/absent × split/fused four-cell table must show separable slot/configuration effects, with a second-page kain-family control.
items.failure_risk: The full rectangle is confined to f80v and neighbor differences may be line-specific.
items.smallest_next_task: Build a raw source-group table for all four cells and matched f77r/f85r1 kain controls before any gloss.

items.shared_mechanism: otedy is a reusable written stem; qotedy and terminal -am forms are local branches with different roles.
items.close_rival: Independent lexemes or a paragraph line-end template.
items.distinguishing_consequence: qotedy must share otedy's neighbor inventory with a declared q-conditioned slot change, while otam/otedam/tdam preserve a terminal configuration across lines.
items.failure_risk: All informative cases cluster on one physical paragraph and may be formulaic.
items.smallest_next_task: Score exact stem, q, ending, line-position, and neighbor tables across the full exposed paragraph; stop if only position explains the split.

items.shared_mechanism: A local qok frame links an operator variant to an olkain/olshedy content pair.
items.close_rival: A fixed phrase or independent words whose order is imposed by paragraph grammar.
items.distinguishing_consequence: The olshedy→qokeedy direction must recur at two physical loci and qok absence in f80v.36 must change the declared frame configuration.
items.failure_risk: Only f80v.33 supplies qokeedy-qoker-olkain-olshedy; shorter repeats may be stock wording.
items.smallest_next_task: Make a qok-present/qok-absent exact-order table with the f80v.36 control and preserve all reader boundaries.

root_review_corrections.reason: No source files were copied into this batch; the already cited pilot paths are the actual bound inputs.
